mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 65 degrees and clear at Reddan Soccer Park. We also have a great view of the ISS tonight starting at 7:43 PM for five minutes, rising in the northwest near Verona High School and heading toward Fitchburg, appearing about halfway up the sky.

The city has announced that fall leaf pickup starts on October 5, requiring loose leaves behind the curb. Also, the plan commission is reviewing several development projects this Monday, including site plans for the Liberty Business Park.

Today is a busy one in Verona with the downtown farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park, pizza and a pitcher at the Wisconsin Brewing Company, and trivia at the Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, make sure to check out Hop Haus trivia at 6:30 PM.
In a report covering late August through mid-September, on September 3, a 33-year-old Madison man was arrested for O W I second offence after a crash on Shooting Star Road.
Please be advised that the Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a building remodel.
